name: hud_ui_polyline_draw
description: HudUiPolyline::Draw dispatches its base draw slot, then draws either clipped or unclipped adjacent line segments for the current point list.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiPolyline/HudUiSliderBorder source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4bf900 validates base ftable slot 2 dispatch, no-op return for zero points, clipped path through zRndr_DrawClippedImmediateLineStrip(points, pointCount - 1, clipRect, color565), and unclipped adjacent segment loop through zRndr_DrawImmediateLine.

Native smoke zhud_polyline_draw_and_slider_update_smoke installs test base draw and rasterizer callbacks, verifies base draw dispatch, verifies two unclipped segment dispatches, and verifies two clipped segment dispatches.
